title: ID0444789-DC/Si-D/BR-Y2/R3 313020197001] Charger offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue: We noticed that station Y2/R3 313020197001  has been updated to version V7.0.5-0. However, the charger is still showing as offline on our plataform.
Solution: Connection restarted by itself

additional_info.subject: Station ( Y2/R3 313020197001 ) - Offline after Update
additional_info.body:
Good morning,
We noticed that station
Y2/R3 313020197001

Best regards.
